name: PrintRanges
description: A collection of all the PrintRange objects in the specified presentation. Each PrintRange object represents a range of consecutive slides or pages to be printed.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Start As Long, End As Long) As PrintRange
methods.description: Returns a PrintRange object that represents a new print range to be added to the PrintRanges collection.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: The number of the slide that is the starting slide in the range.

parameters.name: End
parameters.description: The number of the slide that is the ending slide in the range.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all the print ranges from the PrintRanges collection. Use the Add method of the PrintRanges collection to add print ranges to the collection.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single PrintRange object from the specified PrintRanges collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single PrintRange object in the collection to be returned.
